name: <Room name>

style.summary: <this room's style in the person's words, e.g. bright Japandi with floor seating, or maximalist with collected art>

sourcing.note: furniture/practical: new | secondhand | vintage-antique | custom | existing | mix (ask the person)

frame: Origin at the plan-SW interior corner. x = plan east, y = plan north (labels: true north is site.northDeg), z = up. Plan rotation: rot 0 = item front faces plan south (-y), 90 = east, 180 = north, 270 = west.

scan.note: Fill from tools/align_and_render.py output (GLTF_TRANSFORM) and the measured SW corner.

wall.note: paint brand + code + sheen; replace the hex with the paint's

floor.note: Ask what the floor is. Wood: "texture": "laminate_floor_02" with the floor's average colour as hex; tile, stone, terrazzo, concrete, carpet or tatami: "texture": "none" with its colour as hex.

night.label: Night with the lights on: replace with the scenes this household uses (ask how the room is lit after dark)
